verdict.rationale: OpenAI's speech-to-text API guide documents uploading audio and receiving a final or streamed transcript, file limits and formats, JSON responses, and tunable parameters, with an official CLI wrapper. The open-source package also exposes a documented Python API (load_model/transcribe plus lower-level detect_language/decode), and an llms.txt docs hub is available. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), explicit endpoint/auth reference details in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the hosted API, and an explicit mapping of the Whisper model name to the documented API (the docs reference gpt-transcribe).
